message: I found myself sitting at the kitchen table today, a bit smug if I’m honest, with my trusty weather map and a full water bottle by my side. It feels good to finally be the one who’s ready for whatever nature throws our way. I used to be the last-minute scramble kind of gal, but now I’m embracing a little calm prep. Who knew that a little organization could feel so satisfying? What’s your favorite tip for staying ready during storm season?
